regime_context: The detector shows a broad, two-tier precious-metals leadership (Gold Miners, then Silver & Royalties) with high breadth but mixed trend-health (Hurst mixed) and no one-narrative structure. Momentum rank is a focus lens only; the sole validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), though dir_accuracy is only 0.372 across 86 calls, so direction calls should default humble.
emerging_watch: Watching Pipelines & Midstream (rank 8, trend-tagged but breadth 0.0): I would retire this watch if XEG.TO-adjacent energy breadth or Pipelines/Midstream breadth stays at 0.0 through two consecutive detector snapshots, or if it flips to Hurst 'mixed'/'mean-revert' — currently it is trend-but-empty, so it is a watch on whether any participation actually forms.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the eligible, scorable leader with the highest durability_bar (0.66), broad breadth (0.933), and no crowding flag. Combined with the validated absolute-trend gate, this supports staying with the leader as the trend-following, drawdown-aware leg — but rank-IC ~0 means no return forecast is warranted.
theses.dissent: Hurst_tag is 'mixed' (not cleanly trending) and r10 is -0.0054; precious metals can mean-revert violently if real rates or USD turn. The 0.709 hit_rate overstates directional edge — dir_accuracy is only 0.372.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by more than 5% cumulative over any 20-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the #2 ranked theme, eligible, scorable, with similar breadth (0.917) and durability (0.63) to Gold Miners, and no crowding. The rotation margin to the leader is small (0.173), suggesting precious-metals leadership is broad rather than a single-stock phenomenon — a trend-following stance on the complex is reasonable, but the call is direction-only and rank carries no alpha.
evidence: margin to leader only 0.173 (cohesive PM complex)
theses.dissent: Silver is a higher-beta, more industrial precious metal; it can diverge from gold on a growth scare or dollar rally. Same Hurst 'mixed' fragility applies, and dir_accuracy of 0.372 argues for low conviction.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO lags the S&P/TSX benchmark by more than 5% cumulative over any 20-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper ranks 3rd and is eligible/scorable, but its Hurst_tag is 'mean-revert' — the trend-health leg that gives the detector its only validated edge is absent. Breadth is moderate (0.667) and durability is lower (0.51). The theme is not a short; it is simply not supported by the trend-gate discipline.
theses.dissent: Copper can have violent supply-driven spikes on mine disruptions or China stimulus; an 'avoid' could miss a sharp tactical move. But mean-revert Hurst argues that move would likely not persist.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO sees a sustained Hurst shift to trend/tag persistent with durability above 0.6 while remaining eligible before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
